verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's own configuration documents pulling in music and sound effects you are allowed to use, via Openverse with no key needed, and it logs licenses for anything found online. So scene audio can be added within the same tool, but it is sourced stock audio, not generated. The reference breakdown includes BPM, which hints at rhythm matching, but nothing documents fitting audio to individual scenes. Missing for 10: generated (not sourced) SFX, ambient or music; documented scene-matched audio selection or placement; ambient audio specifically; any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: More images, music and sound effects you're allowed to use (optional, Openverse works without a key)
Anything it finds online gets logged with its source, author and license.
Shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves.
